channel.title: Global portal on product recalls
channel.description: List of recalls created in the Global Portal on Product Recalls since 7 days, as of Wed, 21 Oct 2026.

item.title: Children's vampire capes and witch brooms
item.description: The vampire capes are made of black vinyl. The edges of the cape are scalloped. The capes are packaged in a plastic sleeve with a cardboard insert, which reads in part, "Child's Vinyl Vampire Cape...No. 50282...Made in China." The Rubie's logo and a picture of a boy wearing the cape are also on the insert. The witch brooms are 27 inches long with a bamboo handle and brush made of twigs. The brooms were sold with a sticker around the handle, which reads in part, "Child's Authentic Witch Broom...Style No. 85." The Rubie's logo is also on the sticker.
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: Fisher-Price Power Wheels
item.description: The recalled Power Wheels cars and trucks have been sold under nearly 100 model names. The Power Wheels logo and the model name are on each vehicle. All models with two batteries are recalled, and certain models with one battery are recalled. The company will help consumers identify if their model is part of the recall. Power Wheels cars and trucks are intended for children 2 to 7 years old, and the vehicles' speed ranges from 1 to 5 mph, depending on the model. Power Wheels sold after October 1998 are not involved in this recall.
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: Bi-fold Doors
item.description: These very large doors, used for barns, aircraft hangars and commercial buildings, roll up from the bottom to open and fold the door in half as it raises. These doors can be up to 150 feet wide. Writing on the doors includes, "Schweiss Chicken Pluckers."
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: Stuffed Crab Toys
item.description: This recall involves only stuffed crabs that have antennas with wires and that have the letters "BSW" on the Great American Toy Co. label attached to the toy. The stuffed crabs are either blue and green or red and orange.

item.title: SIMOND Climbing Quickdraw
item.description: The wire gate on certain SIMOND climbing quickdraws sold from January 1, 2022, through July 22, 2026, may have a defective riveted connection. This assembly defect may cause the wire gate to break, creating a risk that the quickdraw could fail during a fall and posing a serious fall and injury hazard. To determine whether your product is affected by this defect, please refer to the inspection instructions available at: https://simondrecallquickdraw.fandi.fr How to Inspect the Product 1.Check both sides of the wire gate to ensure that the wire remains securely attached to the quickdraw. 2.Hold the quickdraw firmly with one hand. Place your thumb between the two wires, with your thumb positioned close to the riveted connection. As shown in the inspection instructions, apply firm downward pressure to the wire gate. 3.Turn the quickdraw over and repeat the same inspection on the opposite side of the wire gate. If the product passes the inspection and is not affected by the defect, consumers may continue to use it. If the inspection indicates that the product is affected by the defect, immediately stop using the product and return it to any Decathlon store for a refund.
item.dcterms:creator: Chinese Taipei

item.title: Xalirium Adult Portable Bed Rails
item.description: This recall involves Xalirium-branded adult portable bed rails. They have a white frame with black foam rubber grips and a black fabric pouch. The bed rails measure about 17.15 inches high, 4.33 inches wide and 1.99 inches long. "Xalirium" is printed on the label of the product packaging. Only bed rails without vertical bars inside the opening are included in this recall.
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: 101 Dalmatians Faux Leather Coin Purses
item.description: This recall involves the Primark 101 Dalmatians Faux Leather Coin Purse, Model No. 2595301. The coin purse is black and has a picture of a dalmatian and "101 Dalmatians" printed on the front. The model number is located on the product tag attached to the zip puller.
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: Papablic Bedside Sleepers with Play Yard Extensions
item.description: This recall involves Papablic bedside sleepers, model PAPA03001AI. These convertible sleepers function as both a bassinet and a play yard and have a gray exterior with an interior printed in a stars-and-moon pattern. The products have "Papablic" stitched in white on the front gray fabric panel. Model "PAPA03001AI" is printed on a label sewn to the interior fabric of the bassinet underneath the mattress pad.
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: Crystal Glass Cups with Loose Crystal Chips
item.description: This recall affects Crystal Glass Cups containing loose crystal stone chips between two layers of glass. The cups are intended for both decorative use and drinking. Each cup measures approximately 3.5 by 3 inches. The crystal stone chips are sold in various options: amethyst, black obsidian, rose quartz, smoke quartz, fire and clear quartz, moss agate, hematite, black tourmaline, black tourmaline in quartz, charoite, blue apatite, morganite, larimar, red jasper, malachite, garnet, kunzite, fluorite, peridot, aquamarine, watermelon tourmaline, carnelian, lapis lazuli, tigers eye and labradorite.
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: Blitz and Blitz 777 air rifles
item.description: This recall involves all units of the Hatsan Blitz and Blitz 777 pellet shooting air rifles sold from February 2020 through March 2026. Both the Blitz and Blitz 777 pellet air rifles were sold in .22, .25 and .30 calibers. The pellet air rifles are gas operated and select-fire (semi-auto/full-auto) pre-charged pneumatic (PCP). They are black and feature a synthetic stock, a carbon fiber air tank mounted beneath the barrel and a rotary magazine feed. Serial numbers and manufacturing dates are engraved on the right side of the receiver above the bolt. On the left side of the receiver is the Hatsan logo, featuring a circular mark, with the word "HATSAN" next to a graphic of a bow and arrow. The model name "BLITZ" or "BLITZ 777" is also marked on the left side of the receiver.
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: Scotch™ Thermal Laminators
item.description: This recall involves the Scotch™ thermal laminator, model number TL1302Z. The laminator is light gray/white with gray accents and the word "Scotch" is printed in gray on the front. The laminating slot is approximately 13 inches wide, and the machine has a carrying handle on the right side of the machine when viewing from the front. The model number TL1302Z is located on the sticker on the bottom of the laminator and can also be found on the product packaging.
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: Panasonic Front-Loading Washer-Dryer Units
item.description: This recall involves Panasonic front-loading washer-dryer units, models NA-LX126BL, NA-LX128BL, and NA-LX128BR, manufactured between September 2022 and July 2025. Detergent or fabric softener may leak from the connections of the automatic dispensing system and drip onto electrical wiring. Under certain circumstances, deterioration of the wire insulation may cause a short circuit, resulting in overheating, smoke, or burning damage. In most cases, the units will automatically shut down and become inoperable. In rare cases, the defect may result in smoke and burning damage.
item.dcterms:creator: Chinese Taipei
